# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:config` from src/config/schema.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

All settings live in `config.yaml`; secrets live in `.env`. Unknown keys are rejected, so a typo
fails at startup with the path of the offending key. Run `pnpm config:check` to validate a file
without starting anything.

## `user`

Who the bot is searching for.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `user.timezone` | string |  | **Required.** Your IANA time zone, for example "Europe/Amsterdam". |
| `user.country` | string |  | **Required.** Your country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. |
| `user.country_aliases` | list of string | `[]` | Extra spellings of your country to recognise in postings (other languages, abbreviations). |

## `app`

Process-wide settings.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `app.log_level` | `trace` \| `debug` \| `info` \| `warn` \| `error` \| `fatal` | `"info"` | Log verbosity. The LOG_LEVEL environment variable overrides it. |
| `app.user_agent_contact` | string | `""` | Optional URL or email appended to the User-Agent so site owners can reach you. Empty sends "job-scout/<version>" only. |

## `schedule`

Collector scheduling.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schedule.default_interval_minutes` | integer | `15` | How often each source is polled unless it sets its own interval. |
| `schedule.max_concurrent_sources` | integer | `3` | How many sources may be fetched at the same time. |

## `sources`

Where jobs come from. Every source is optional and off by default.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sources.rss` | object |  | Generic RSS/Atom source for job boards that publish feeds for saved searches. |
| `sources.rss.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Turn this source on or off. |
| `sources.rss.interval_minutes` | integer |  | Polling interval for this source. Falls back to schedule.default_interval_minutes. |
| `sources.rss.feeds` | list of object | `[]` | Feeds to poll. |
| `sources.rss.feeds[].id` | string |  | **Required.** Unique name for this feed, shown in /status and on cards. |
| `sources.rss.feeds[].url` | string |  | **Required.** RSS or Atom feed URL. |
| `sources.rss.feeds[].title_pattern` | string |  | Optional regex applied to the item title, for feeds that pack several fields into it. Named groups "title", "company", "location" and "salary" are used when present, e.g. "^(?<title>.+) at (?<company>.+)$". |
| `sources.rss.feeds[].defaults` | object |  | Values assumed for every item of the feed when the feed does not carry them. |
| `sources.rss.feeds[].defaults.company` | string |  | Company name when the feed has none. |
| `sources.rss.feeds[].defaults.remote` | boolean |  | true: every item is remote. false: an item is on-site unless its text says remote. Omit when the feed mixes both without saying. |
| `sources.rss.feeds[].defaults.employment_type` | `full_time` \| `part_time` \| `contract` |  | Employment type when the feed does not state it. |
| `sources.greenhouse` | object |  | Greenhouse public job board API. |
| `sources.greenhouse.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Turn this source on or off. |
| `sources.greenhouse.interval_minutes` | integer |  | Polling interval for this source. Falls back to schedule.default_interval_minutes. |
| `sources.greenhouse.boards` | list of string | `[]` | Greenhouse board slugs to watch (the part after /boards/ in the board URL). |
| `sources.ashby` | object |  | Ashby public job posting API. |
| `sources.ashby.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Turn this source on or off. |
| `sources.ashby.interval_minutes` | integer |  | Polling interval for this source. Falls back to schedule.default_interval_minutes. |
| `sources.ashby.boards` | list of string | `[]` | Ashby job board names to watch (the part after jobs.ashbyhq.com/). |
| `sources.lever` | object |  | Lever public postings API. Not implemented yet. |
| `sources.lever.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Turn this source on or off. |
| `sources.lever.interval_minutes` | integer |  | Polling interval for this source. Falls back to schedule.default_interval_minutes. |
| `sources.lever.companies` | list of string | `[]` | Lever company slugs to watch. |
| `sources.himalayas` | object |  | Himalayas public remote-jobs API. Not implemented yet. |
| `sources.himalayas.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Turn this source on or off. |
| `sources.himalayas.interval_minutes` | integer |  | Polling interval for this source. Falls back to schedule.default_interval_minutes. |
| `sources.himalayas.queries` | list of string | `[]` | Search queries. |
| `sources.remotive` | object |  | Remotive public remote-jobs API. Not implemented yet. |
| `sources.remotive.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Turn this source on or off. |
| `sources.remotive.interval_minutes` | integer |  | Polling interval for this source. Falls back to schedule.default_interval_minutes. |
| `sources.remotive.category` | string |  | Remotive category slug. |
| `sources.remotive.search` | list of string | `[]` | Search terms. |
| `sources.remoteok` | object |  | RemoteOK public remote-jobs API. Not implemented yet. |
| `sources.remoteok.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Turn this source on or off. |
| `sources.remoteok.interval_minutes` | integer |  | Polling interval for this source. Falls back to schedule.default_interval_minutes. |
| `sources.remoteok.tags` | list of string | `[]` | Tags to query. |
| `sources.jobicy` | object |  | Jobicy public remote-jobs API. Not implemented yet. |
| `sources.jobicy.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Turn this source on or off. |
| `sources.jobicy.interval_minutes` | integer |  | Polling interval for this source. Falls back to schedule.default_interval_minutes. |
| `sources.jobicy.tags` | list of string | `[]` | Tags to query. |
| `sources.telegram_channels` | object |  | Reads posts from Telegram channels through YOUR OWN account (TG_API_ID, TG_API_HASH, TG_SESSION). Disabled by default. Not implemented yet. |
| `sources.telegram_channels.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Turn this source on or off. |
| `sources.telegram_channels.interval_minutes` | integer |  | Polling interval for this source. Falls back to schedule.default_interval_minutes. |
| `sources.telegram_channels.channels` | list of string | `[]` | Public channel usernames to read, without the leading "@". |

## `dedup`

How duplicates across sources are merged.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dedup.window_days` | integer | `14` | Two postings with the same company and title are the same job when seen within this many days. |
| `dedup.primary_source_priority` | list of string | `["greenhouse","ashby","lever","rss"]` | Source types ordered by which link becomes the primary one. Employer ATS links come first by default. |

## `filters`

Rule filter. Every rule is optional; every drop records a reason code.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filters.max_age_days` | number |  | Drop postings published more than this many days ago. Omit to keep any age. |
| `filters.title` | object |  | Title keyword rules. Matching is case-insensitive on whole words. |
| `filters.title.include_any` | list of string | `[]` | Keep only titles containing at least one of these. Empty keeps all. |
| `filters.title.exclude_any` | list of string | `[]` | Drop titles containing any of these. |
| `filters.seniority` | object |  | Seniority rules, matched against the title. |
| `filters.seniority.include_any` | list of string | `[]` | Seniority words you want, e.g. senior, lead. Empty keeps all. |
| `filters.seniority.exclude_any` | list of string | `[]` | Seniority words to drop, e.g. junior, staff. |
| `filters.seniority.keep_if_unstated` | boolean | `true` | Keep titles that state no seniority at all (marked on the card). |
| `filters.stack` | object |  | Technology rules. |
| `filters.stack.required_any` | list of string | `[]` | The title or description must mention at least one of these. Empty keeps all. |
| `filters.stack.exclude_primary` | list of string | `[]` | Languages or platforms you do not want as the main one. Dropped when named in the title; flagged when the description leans on them. |
| `filters.employment` | object |  | Which employment types to keep. Postings that do not state a type are kept. |
| `filters.employment.full_time` | object |  |  |
| `filters.employment.full_time.allowed` | boolean | `true` | Keep postings of this employment type. |
| `filters.employment.part_time` | object |  |  |
| `filters.employment.part_time.allowed` | boolean | `true` | Keep postings of this employment type. |
| `filters.employment.contract` | object |  |  |
| `filters.employment.contract.allowed` | boolean | `true` | Keep postings of this employment type. |
| `filters.location` | object |  | Location rules. |
| `filters.location.allowed_regions` | list of string | `[]` | Regions you accept for remote roles, e.g. worldwide, europe, emea. Regions that contain your country are always accepted. |
| `filters.location.allowed_countries` | list of string |  | Extra countries you accept besides your own (ISO codes). |
| `filters.location.blocked_countries` | list of string |  | Drop postings whose stated countries are all in this list. |
| `filters.location.require_user_country_when_restricted` | boolean | `true` | Drop postings restricted to a list of countries or regions that does not include yours. When false they are kept and flagged. |
| `filters.location.onsite_cities_allowed` | list of string | `[]` | Cities where on-site or hybrid work is acceptable. Empty means remote only. |
| `filters.location.always_blocked` | object |  | Hard blocks that win over every other location rule. |
| `filters.location.always_blocked.countries` | list of string |  | Drop any posting that names one of these countries as a location. |
| `filters.location.always_blocked.signals` | list of string | `[]` | Drop any posting whose title, company, description or URL contains one of these keywords or domains. |
| `filters.location.keep_if_unstated` | boolean | `true` | Keep postings with no usable location information (marked on the card). |
| `filters.location.remote_keywords` | list of string | `[]` | Extra words that mean "remote" in the language of your sources. English wording is built in. |
| `filters.location.extra_aliases` | map of string to string | `{}` | Extra place names mapped to an ISO country code or a region id, e.g. { "benelux": "europe" }. |
| `filters.pay` | object |  | Pay floors. A posting is dropped only when the top of its stated range is below the floor. |
| `filters.pay.currency` | string |  | Currency of the floors below. |
| `filters.pay.full_time_min_monthly` | number |  | Monthly floor for full-time roles. Omit for no floor. |
| `filters.pay.hourly_min` | number |  | Hourly floor for part-time and contract roles. Omit for no floor. |
| `filters.pay.hours_per_month` | number | `160` | Used to convert between hourly and monthly pay. |
| `filters.pay.keep_if_unstated` | boolean | `true` | Keep postings that state no pay (marked "pay not stated"). |
| `filters.pay.fx_rates` | map of string to number | `{}` | Static conversion table: value of 1 unit of each currency in `currency`. Postings in a currency missing here are kept and flagged. |
| `filters.hours` | object |  | Working-hours rules. |
| `filters.hours.must_finish_by` | string |  | Latest local time you are willing to work until, in user.timezone. |
| `filters.hours.drop_partial_overlap` | boolean | `false` | What to do with stated working hours that start before must_finish_by but end after it: drop (true) or keep and flag (false). |
| `filters.hours.drop_patterns` | list of string | `[]` | Regular expressions (case-insensitive) that drop a posting when found in its text. |
| `filters.hours.flag_patterns` | list of string | `[]` | Regular expressions (case-insensitive) that keep the posting but flag it for a closer look. |

## `scoring`

Optional LLM scoring (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scoring.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Score kept jobs with an LLM. Not implemented yet. |
| `scoring.model` | string | `"claude-sonnet-5-5"` | Anthropic model name. |
| `scoring.daily_budget_usd` | number | `1` | Hard cap on daily LLM spend. |
| `scoring.priorities` | list of object | `[]` | Priority buckets, best first. |
| `scoring.priorities[].label` | string |  | **Required.** Short label shown on cards. |
| `scoring.priorities[].definition` | string |  | **Required.** What qualifies a job for this bucket. |

## `telegram`

Telegram delivery (requires TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN).

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `telegram.allowed_chat_ids` | list of integer | `[]` | Chats that receive cards and may use the bot. Leave empty on first start: /start replies with your chat ID. |
| `telegram.rate_limit` | object |  | Outgoing message throttling. |
| `telegram.rate_limit.messages_per_minute` | integer | `20` | Upper bound on messages the bot sends per chat per minute. |
| `telegram.batch_threshold` | integer | `5` | When more than this many jobs are waiting, send one digest message instead of cards. |
| `telegram.snooze_hours` | list of integer | `[4,24,72]` | Choices offered by the Snooze button, in hours. |
| `telegram.reject_reasons` | list of string | `["Location","Pay","Hours","Stack","Level","Not interested"]` | Choices offered by the Reject button. Stored to tune filters later. |
| `telegram.digest` | object |  | Scheduled daily digest. |
| `telegram.digest.enabled` | boolean | `false` | Send a daily summary. Not implemented yet. |
| `telegram.digest.time` | string | `"09:00"` | Local time of the daily summary. |

## `tracker`

Application tracker.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tracker.type` | `postgres` \| `notion` | `"postgres"` | Where "Add to tracker" writes. "postgres" is built in and needs no setup. Tracked jobs are always also recorded locally. |
| `tracker.liveness_check` | boolean | `true` | Re-check that a posting is still open before adding it to the tracker. |
| `tracker.closed_patterns` | list of string | `[]` | Extra regular expressions (case-insensitive) that mark a posting page as closed, for boards whose wording the built-in English patterns miss. |
| `tracker.notion` | object |  | Notion adapter settings (requires NOTION_TOKEN). |
| `tracker.notion.data_source_id` | string |  | **Required.** ID of the Notion data source to write to. In Notion: database menu → "Manage data sources" → copy the data source ID. |
| `tracker.notion.api_version` | string | `"2026-03-11"` | Notion-Version header sent with every request. |
| `tracker.notion.properties` | map of string to string | `{}` | Job field -> your Notion property name. Fields: company, title, url, links, salary, location, work_format, employment, source, priority, status, industry, posted_at, added_at. Property types are read from Notion, so any title, text, URL, select, multi-select, status, date or number property works. Unmapped fields are not written. |
| `tracker.notion.values` | map of string to map of string to string | `{}` | Per-field value mapping, e.g. work_format: { remote: Remote, onsite: Office }. For `source` the keys are source ids or types and may end with "*", e.g. { "rss:board-*": Board, greenhouse: "Company website" }. |
| `tracker.notion.defaults` | map of string to string \| number \| boolean | `{}` | Values written on every insert, keyed by a job field from `properties` or by a Notion property name, e.g. status: "To Apply". |
| `tracker.notion.create_select_options` | boolean | `false` | Let Notion create a missing select option. When false, a value that is not an existing option is skipped and reported on the card. |
| `tracker.notion.auto_number` | object |  | Optional running number for new rows: the current maximum plus one. |
| `tracker.notion.auto_number.property` | string |  | **Required.** Number property that receives a running number. |
| `tracker.notion.auto_number.strategy` | `max_plus_one` | `"max_plus_one"` |  |

## `application`

"Prepare application" drafts. Not implemented yet.

| Key | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `application.profile_file` | string | `"profile.md"` | Path to your profile, relative to the config file. |
| `application.language` | string | `"en"` | Language of generated texts. |
| `application.cover_letter_max_words` | integer | `180` |  |
| `application.style_rules` | list of string | `[]` | Free-form writing rules passed to the generator. |

## Environment variables

| Variable | Required | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` | bot | Token from @BotFather. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | bot, worker | PostgreSQL connection string. |
| `CONFIG_PATH` | no | Path to the config file. Defaults to `config.yaml`. |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | no | Overrides `app.log_level`. |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | no | LLM scoring and application drafts (planned). |
| `NOTION_TOKEN` | with Notion | Secret of your Notion integration. |
| `TG_API_ID`, `TG_API_HASH`, `TG_SESSION` | no | Telegram channel reader (planned). |
